test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. O is an immediate neighbour of M. Only two people sit between O and Q. P sits second to the left of R. N is an immediate neighbour of P. Who is sitting second to the right of M?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only two people sit between O and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e5aec28f18183dd238bc76d2fd845588e5327d05387baafde478e0c01f9cd4b.png] 

2) O is an immediate neighbour of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566de0024aee0499e83af0863e8cee87b18651ec1f0bbd8668f5188c9d67951e.png] 

3) P sits second to the left of R.

4) N is an immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c88ddf1e3dbd97da2763551107711bb0cc8c17632149269726f4bd357f480b7.png] 

Here, we can see that N is sitting second to the right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"N"**.
